First, I need to understand the question: "in what other year other than 1935/36 were championships held without playoffs?"  
The answer type is a year (or years) from the table, with cardinality possibly one or more.  
I must filter rows where:  
- "Playoffs" column indicates a championship without playoffs.  
- Exclude the year 1935/36 as specified.  

Looking at the "Playoffs" column:  
- "Champion (no playoff)" appears in two rows:  
  1. 1935/36 – which is to be excluded.  
  2. 1953/54 – "Champion (no playoff)".  

No other rows have "Champion (no playoff)". Other rows have "No playoff", "Did not qualify", "1st Round", "Finals", etc., but those are not championships. Only "Champion (no playoff)" indicates a championship without playoffs.  

Thus, the only other year is 1953/54.  

Final Answer: 1953/54
